title: graceful-reopen-gate-and-transient-mute-recovery-hotfix
author: Priya Desai
description: Summary: Fix oscillatory reopen behavior after emergency load-shedding and add a guarded, telemetry-driven reopen gate with a transient-mute recovery window. Motivation: During the incident on 2025-10-29 we observed tenants repeatedly flip between shed and active states when the quick-reopen path allowed immediate rejoin; that caused downstream KV pressure spikes and increased tail latency. This patch introduces a controlled reopen gate that enforces a graded thaw interval and a rate-limited reopen token. The gate is governed by two signals: (1) local reopen_quiet_count (per-node counter of successful quiet windows) and (2) cluster-level reopen_budget sampled from recent SLO headroom metrics. Changes: - Implement ReopenGate in serving/runtime: enforces minimum quiet interval, exponential backoff on repeated failures, and a token bucket for reopen attempts. - Add TransientMuteRecovery in router/fallback: tenants moved to transient-mute state are permitted staged reinstate with diminishing concurrency until stability. - Telemetry: new metrics reopen_attempts_allowed, reopen_backoff_state, transient_mute_count and reopen_budget_percent; dashboard panels added. - Tests: unit + integration tests to reproduce fast-flip scenario and assert monotonic backoff. - Ops: rollout is a canary on 2 nodes per region with feature flag reopen_gate.v1; fallback to legacy immediate-reopen on config toggle. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to canary cluster and monitor reopen_attempts_allowed and transient_mute_count for 48h. 2) If false positives / increased long-tail latency, revert via feature toggle. 3) Gradual ramp to 50% of nodes, then full rollout. Backwards compatibility: config defaults to enabled=false; enable only for SRE supervised rollouts. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test reproduces flip - [x] Telemetry emitted to metrics backend - [x] Ops runbook updated (ops/reopen-gate-runbook.md) Related: ENG-1198 (post-incident), SRE-451 (runbook).

review_thread: Marco Ruiz (2025-11-07): Nice narrow hotfix. Two asks: (a) add a metric that counts failed reopen attempts per tenant to help SRE triage; (b) consider a short jitter on the backoff to avoid thundering reopens.
Priya Desai (2025-11-07): Added reopen_failed_attempts metric and jittered backoff implementation (configurable). PTAL.
Elena Park (2025-11-08): Tests look good. One nit: the default enable flag should be false in helm values (I verified it's false). Approved after CI passes.
Samir Khan (2025-11-08): Verified integration reproduction; +1 for merge. Recommend squash merge to keep history clean.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent rapid reopen/evict oscillation by gating tenant reinstates after emergency shedding. Adds guarded reopen gate with telemetry and ops runbook.
backout_instructions: Flip helm flag reopen_gate.enabled=false and deploy; if issues persist, revert chart to previous release-tag and notify SRE via #incidents.
testing_notes: Integration harness includes synthetic spike generator that alternates aggressive shedding; verify reopen_attempts_allowed stays below configured token allowance and transient_mute_count stabilizes within 2x baseline.
notes_for_sre: Dashboard panels: reopen_budget_percent, reopen_backoff_state, reopen_failed_attempts. Alert if reopen_failed_attempts > 100/min for 5m or reopen_budget_percent drops below 10% for >10m. Runbook at ops/reopen-gate-runbook.md.
operational_impact: Low when disabled. When enabled, expect reduced immediate rejoin throughput for tenants recently evicted; overall goal is to lower KV pressure and tail latency at cost of delayed reinstates.
